name: OpenSpec (SDD метод)
description: OpenSpec — AI-native система для spec-driven development. Бандл из 12 skill-ов (skills/openspec-*) в едином контуре + CLI `openspec` (npm @fission-ai/openspec 1.17.0, bin openspec). Метод: change → propose → apply → verify. Установка одного бандла-ассета; дробление на 12 карточек ломает метод (перекрёстные ссылки и поток workflow сохраняются только в едином дереве). CLI помещается как vendor'd npm-тарбол по AD-15.

install.payload: skills/ (12-skill SDD method tree: openspec-*/SKILL.md + README) + cli/openspec-1.17.0.tgz (vendor'd npm CLI, AD-15)
steps: Place the vendored skills/ tree into the device/project skills folder (as a skill group, preserving the openspec-* names and cross-references).
Each openspec-*/SKILL.md registers by its frontmatter (name: openspec-<step>; description drives the trigger; allowed-tools: Bash(openspec:*)).
Install the CLI: extract cli/openspec-1.17.0.tgz and provision the Node production-dependency closure (per AD-15 closed-supply). `openspec --version` then reports 1.17.0.
The skills drive the `openspec` CLI: `openspec new change` → `openspec propose` → `openspec apply change` → `openspec verify change`; `openspec onboard` runs guided setup.

compatibility.runtime: Node >=22.12 (the `openspec` CLI npm package; production dependency closure must be provisioned per AD-15 — the tarball itself is vendored, the transitive deps are not). Skills are self-contained instructions and install regardless; full CLI use requires the dep closure.
